description: Learn AI Engineering! Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.

summary.one_liner: A free, MIT-licensed AI engineering curriculum of 542 lessons across 20 phases, with Python, TypeScript, Rust and Julia code for building model internals, retrieval pipelines and agent runtimes from scratch.
summary.what_it_does: The repository is a large course organized as 20 phases, from setup and math foundations through classical ML, deep learning, vision, NLP, speech, transformers, generative AI, RL, LLMs, LLM engineering, multimodal AI, tools and protocols, agent engineering, and later production and ethics phases. Each lesson is labeled as Build or Learn and lists its language, with code run from the repository root. The README also describes three graded projects (retrieval evaluation with ranking metrics, an agent trace debugger in TypeScript, and a Rust tool-call firewall) that come with staged starters and a local grader script. An optional AI tutor mode is set up through npx skills, with skills for onboarding, lesson-by-lesson teaching, quizzes and focused MCP, Agent Skills and reverse engineering paths. The README is published in many translated languages. Lesson content is also available on the project website.
use_cases: Learn machine learning and deep learning from first principles
Follow a structured path to build LLM applications and RAG systems
Build and test AI agent runtimes with evaluation and tracing
Study the Model Context Protocol (MCP) with a focused route
Practice ranking evaluation and regression checks for retrieval
Learn binary reverse engineering on programs you build yourself
notable: 542 lessons across 20 phases, each labeled Build or Learn, with per-lesson language tags
Three graded projects with staged starters and a strict local grader script
Optional AI tutor mode via npx skills, with placement quiz and per-phase quizzes
Focused learning routes for Model Context Protocol, Agent Skills and reverse engineering
README translated into more than 30 languages
caveats: Full curriculum is very large; estimated times run from about 60 hours (agent engineering only) to about 306 hours (from setup)
Tutor mode needs Node.js, npx and a skill-capable coding agent; focused labs need python3
Projects' starters fail until the stages are implemented, and metrics do not establish answer correctness, per the README
README says some lesson content is in progress or pending real-host evidence for skill paths
